items.question: What is Dormly?
items.answer: Dormly is a platform designed to help university students find their ideal dorm roommate based on lifestyle habits and personality compatibility.

items.question: How does the compatibility test work?
items.answer: Our test analyzes your answers regarding daily routines, cleanliness, social habits, and dorm living preferences to find roommates with the highest match score.

items.question: Is Dormly free to use?
items.answer: Yes, all core features of Dormly (profile creation, habit testing, and searching for roommates) are completely free for students.

items.question: Can I update my test answers later?
items.answer: Absolutely! You can retake the compatibility test anytime or edit your profile details directly in your account settings.

test.alertSelect: Please select an answer to continue!

1.text: How often do you clean your personal space (bed, desk)?

options.1.2: Every few days / When clutter is visible.

2.text: How do you handle dirty dishes?

options.2.2: Can leave them in the sink until morning/evening.
options.2.3: Wash only when clean dishes run out.

3.text: What is the best way to manage shared area cleaning?

options.3.1: Set up a strict rotation schedule.
options.3.2: Clean together on a dedicated day.
options.3.3: Everyone cleans up after themselves when needed.

4.text: What is your typical weekday sleep schedule?

options.4.1: Early bird: Sleep before 23:00, wake up before 08:00.
options.4.2: Night owl: Sleep after 00:00, wake up after 09:00.

5.text: What are your ideal sleeping conditions?

options.5.2: Darkness, but mild background noise is fine.
options.5.3: Deep sleeper: Can sleep through light and noise.

6.text: Attitude towards playing audio/video without headphones?

options.6.2: Low volume is fine if nobody minds.
options.6.3: I like loud sound and see no issue with it.

7.text: How often do you plan to invite guests?

options.7.2: A few times a month (with prior agreement).

8.text: Your ideal evening in the room after classes?

options.8.1: Everyone does their own thing in quiet.
options.8.2: Chats, board games, or watching movies together.

options.9.2: Rarely, and only with everyone's consent.
options.9.3: Completely normal if not overly frequent.

10.text: How to handle shared household expenses (soap, toilet paper)?

options.10.1: Split equally into a shared budget.
options.10.2: Buy on turns (me today, you tomorrow).
options.10.3: Everyone buys and uses their own items.

11.text: Attitude towards roommates borrowing your personal items?

options.11.1: Strictly against it, do not touch my things.
options.11.2: Only with explicit permission each time.
options.11.3: Small items (salt, kitchenware) are fine without asking.

12.text: How do you usually resolve conflicts or misunderstandings?

options.12.1: Directly address what bothers me immediately.
options.12.2: Wait for the right moment for a calm discussion.
options.12.3: Avoid conflict and try to stay quiet.

13.text: What room temperature is most comfortable for you?

options.13.1: Prefer cool air, frequently open windows.
options.13.2: Prefer warm air, keep windows closed.
options.13.3: I adapt easily to any temperature.

14.text: Attitude towards phone/video calls inside the dorm room?

options.14.1: Always step out into the hallway to avoid disturbing.
options.14.2: Talk in the room, but quietly and briefly.
options.14.3: Talk freely, it is my room too.

options.15.1: Regularly cook complex meals (lots of kitchen time).
options.15.2: Quick, simple meals or semi-prepared food.
